moves.wide: the whole scene from a distance
moves.medium_wide: knees-up on the subject, wider than medium
moves.master: the whole room from high and far
moves.slow_push: very slow push on the face at the moment of emotion
moves.follow_side: camera walks beside a walking actor
moves.follow_behind: camera follows a walking actor from behind
moves.lead: camera backs away in front of a walking actor
moves.dolly_zoom: Vertigo: camera moves away, lens narrows, subject keeps its size
moves.eye_level: camera at the subject's eye height, still
moves.low: camera below the eyes, looks up
moves.child_eye: camera at a child's eye height
moves.profile: camera at the side of the face
moves.three_quarter: camera at 40° from the face line
moves.frontal: straight in front of the face (Anderson)
moves.ots: over the shoulder of one of the pair

schemes.over_the_shoulder: shoulder to shoulder, one ots per speaker
schemes.establishing: master shot at the start of a scene
schemes.oner: one chain of moves without a cut
schemes.return_wide: back to a wide at the end of a line
schemes.open_from_light: open on the light, then on the hero
schemes.final_pull_out: last plan of the scene pulls out

records.insert: detail of an object (needs an object)
records.pov: view from the actor's head (needs the inside view)
records.cross_cut: cut between two places (needs two rooms)
